    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.cases = []
        self.subcases = []

    def startTest(self, test):
        self.cases.append({"id": test.id(), "status": "started"})
        super().startTest(test)

    def outcome(self, test, status, error=None):
        row = self.cases[-1]
        if row["id"] != test.id() or row["status"] != "started":
            raise AssertionError("unexpected unittest case callback order")
        row["status"] = status
        if error is not None:
            value = error[1]

            if isinstance(value, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):

                    Path(os.environ["TMPDIR"]))

        self.outcome(test, "ok")
        super().addSuccess(test)

    def addFailure(self, test, error):
        self.outcome(test, "failure", error)
        super().addFailure(test, error)

    def addError(self, test, error):
        self.outcome(test, "error", error)
        super().addError(test, error)

    def addSkip(self, test, reason):
        self.outcome(test, "skip")
        super().addSkip(test, reason)

    def addExpectedFailure(self, test, error):
        self.outcome(test, "expected_failure", error)
        super().addExpectedFailure(test, error)

    def addUnexpectedSuccess(self, test):
        self.outcome(test, "unexpected_success")
        super().addUnexpectedSuccess(test)

    def addSubTest(self, test, subtest, error):
        params = dict(subtest.params)
        if set(params) != {"content"} or not isinstance(params["content"], bytes):
